summary: Extract the same set of fields from PDFs with different layouts and check the values before saving the JSON.
scope: Illustrative design. The scenario assumes three seconds per PDF. The API registers jobs so other uploads can arrive while the workers process documents with bounded concurrency.

componentNotes.web: Send the PDF to the API and follow the status for its job.
componentNotes.api: Receive the upload, register its initial status in Firestore and submit the PDF and job ID to the Go File Processor.
componentNotes.job: Store the initial status from the API and progress updates from the worker. The web client listens for changes to its job.
componentNotes.processor: Process multiple PDFs concurrently within provider limits. Check each field against its expected type, format and supporting text before saving the JSON. Keep missing or ambiguous values null.
componentNotes.ocr: Use embedded text where it is readable and OCR for scans. Fill the agreed JSON schema and attach a source excerpt to each extracted value for validation.
componentNotes.files: Store the validated JSON and its supporting excerpts. A field without a clear value stays null.
